description: ML Storm Forecast by Address. FREE preview: counts of addresses in the forecast path of storms that could happen over the next 24 hours to 10 days, the storm types forecast and the estimated cost (the county's A-F grade is shown as a secondary label). The paid pull (addresses=true, $0.05 per address) returns one record per address with structure_value (USD replacement cost), people (estimated occupants), full_address, lat, lon, county, storm_type, forecast_time and risk_label. Per-peril machine-learning models, refreshed 4 times a day. Could happen, not will.

county.description: County name without the word 'County', e.g. Dallas.

peril.description: Narrows the forecast to one storm type -- check a free preview's storm_types for real values available in this window.

name: get_risk_forecast
